basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old vinyl enthusiast living in Portland, Oregon. By day, I work as a graphic designer, but my evenings are dedicated to exploring the world of music, specifically metal and rock. I spend my weekends hunting for rare records and enjoy visiting local record shops. I have a soft spot for classic video games, with Jak and Daxter being my all-time favorite series. I’m single and currently exploring relationships through various online avenues. My typical online hours are in the late evenings as I wind down from the day.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep understanding of the music industry, particularly in vinyl record collecting, which I’ve cultivated through years of collecting and trading. My interest in video games is supported by a lifelong passion and participation in gaming communities. My knowledge is mainly self-taught, supplemented by reading and engaging with online forums.
